label: Monocyte Oxidative Stress Underlies Persistent Immune Activation in Long COVID Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome.
summary: Long COVID Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome (LCPOTS) is characterized by persistent orthostatic tachycardia and systemic symptoms following SARS-CoV-2 infection. Many features of LCPOTS suggest ongoing immune activation, but the mechanisms driving this response remain unclear.
